corpus.source: kvnloo/bend@17db447a tree (a superset of tag v2.0.34's tests: 5 added files, none changed or removed)
corpus.T: tests/**/*.bend, 1526 files: the official gates/safe.ts 'tests' corpus; every file is run, including helper modules, exactly as the gate does
corpus.P: tests/proof/**/*.bend, 86 files (subset of T, reported on its own as the proof corpus)

S.s1212_fb3: PRIMARY oracle. bendlang/bend issue 1212 fb3.bend + a-b.bend verbatim (the prior kvnloo/hermes-agent#389 oracle). Source computes False{}.
S.s1212_prlaw_nolaw: PRIMARY oracle. The kvnloo/bend#2 regression program (tests/proof/group_name_collision_semantics.bend) with its law and proof removed, so main's certified value is visible in the PR's own file layout.
S.s1212_up_dead_forward_nolaw: PRIMARY oracle. The upstream fix's regression test (tests/proof/group_dead_forward.bend at e1ed2435) with its laws removed; source computes 5n.
S.s1212_fb3_law_false: fb3 + law main == False (claim matching the source): expected fail-closed on a mis-routing release, PASS on a fixed one
S.s1212_fb3_law_true: fb3 + law main == True (claim matching the mis-routed book): must never PASS
S.s1212_prlaw: the PR regression law as committed
S.s1212_up_dead_forward: the upstream regression test as committed (laws helper and non_member)
S.D: DERIVED oracles: every T/X file that the arm certifies (class agree) whose emitted book types main as Bool, Nat or U32 and whose source run prints exactly one literal of that type (Nat <= 4096)

F.meaning: Each file is accepted by bend2 (--check-only) and upstream diagnoses the kernel-side rejection or crash as a defect, so PASS is the correct verdict and anything else is a false negative (fail-closed). Kept separate from semantic false positives.

procedure.direct: run_direct.py per arm: `bend <f> --verdict` from the corpus root, 30 s cap, stdout+stderr merged; on 'Sorry - ' the gates/safe_node.ts follow-up (-o; out-of-scope text or the arm kernel's output on the book); class by gates/safe.ts judge (agree, bend2 rejects, u unsafe, - out of scope, ! false reject, t timeout). Value oracle for every agree case and every b389cases/ case: source run, -o book, main type from the book, then two kernel claims appended to the book: {main == source value} and {main == a different value (not b / n+1 / n+1 mod 2^32)}; certified relation source|different|both|neither. 4 worker threads; first verdict of an arm builds its kernel (bootstrap record kept apart).
procedure.plugin: run_plugin.py per arm: the pinned plugin e85e65e5 exported from the bend-native clone, loaded through Hermes PluginManager in a disposable profile (as scripts/smoke.py), registry.dispatch('bend_verify') per case with project_dir = corpus root and the case written as PROOF.bend in its own directory (removed after). A directory already holding LAWS.bend/PROOF.bend that is not the case itself is layout_na. One profile per process: session-bootstrap once, then session-pinned.
procedure.cli: run_cli.sh: `hermes bend verify` via the INSTALLED plugin in the lane's isolated template profile, arms A (official) and B (BEND_VERIFIER=patched) only, S and F cases only, 1 repetition, one Hermes process per case.
procedure.repetitions: Primary pass: every case once per arm per mode (direct, plugin). S and F: 3 repetitions per arm in direct and plugin modes. Confirmation pass: every T/X case whose direct class differs between any two arms, or is t / harness_error on any arm, or whose plugin pass disagrees with direct agree on its arm, gets 2 more direct runs on all 4 arms. Final class = majority of the 3 runs; a case is flaky when the 3 runs differ. Every run stays in the denominators.
procedure.isolation: all execution via the lane launcher run-hermes.sh (hostless + bwrap masks + env -i + dead proxy); heavy sweeps hold the SHARED quiet-lane lock in blocks of <= 10 min with a ledger line each; never the exclusive lock (no timing).
procedure.pilot_disclosure: Before this file: harness pilots b389-pilot-direct-A-01 (20 cases) and b389-pilot-plugin-A-01 (17 cases) on arm A plus manual pilots under hostless, to debug the harness and learn the BendTT literal encodings. Pilots are excluded from all results.

metrics_per_arm: pass rate: agree / N for T, P and X (direct); plugin pass / N_ran (plugin)
class counts (safe.ts taxonomy), stable and flaky
translation_mismatch: evaluated value oracles (PRIMARY + D on certified cases) with certified in {different, both}
oracle_indeterminate: certified == neither on a certified (agree) case or on a PRIMARY oracle

false negatives: (i) F expected_pass_regressions not PASS; (ii) corpus false rejects '!' and timeouts 't' in T (bend2 checks, kernel does not); '-' out of scope reported separately (fail-closed by design)

new failures introduced by the patch: stable T/X cases agree on A and not agree on B; attributed with C1 (same case also not agree on C1 => from the 6 upstream commits, not the patch) and C2 (not agree on C2 but agree on A => the 2-line patch itself); gains (non-agree on A -> agree on B) listed the same way

plugin/direct consistency: plugin pass where direct is not agree (plugin false pass) and plugin non-pass where direct agrees, excluding layout_na and plugin input-policy errors (reported with their codes)
kernel identity: each arm's direct and plugin kernel sha256 equals the expected value; unchanged across the sweep

acceptance.rule_389_semantic_gate: A release is PROMOTABLE (semantic gate) only if: (1) each PRIMARY oracle's emitted book certifies the source value (certified == source) in all 3 repetitions; (2) translation_mismatch == 0 and oracle_indeterminate == 0 over all D oracles on cases the release certifies; (3) s1212_fb3_law_true never PASSes. Anything missing, errored or indeterminate fails closed (not promotable).
acceptance.preferred_verifier_recommendation: Additionally requires zero stable new failures versus stock in T/X, zero plugin false passes, and the expected kernel identities. Reported separately from the kvnloo/hermes-agent#389 gate so the owner can weigh fail-closed regressions.

predictions.A: not promotable: s1212_fb3 certifies a different value (True) than the source (False), as in kvnloo/hermes-agent#389
predictions.B: PRIMARY oracles certify the source value; corpus outcome unknown
predictions.F: expected FAIL on A and B for 1179/1193/1194 (open upstream); f1212_g4 crash on A, unknown on B

acceptance.authority: A promotable result is evidence for the owner. It does not change the plugin's default executable, mint task success, or attest source semantics; source_semantics_attested stays false.

evidence_labels: SOURCE / UNIT / FIXTURE / REAL / BENCHMARK / BLOCKED / NOT_RUN per row; all sweeps are REAL; no BENCHMARK rows
